text.style: font-size:25px;font-weight:600;font-family:'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif;line-height:1.2
text.tspan: Day of the year with peak cherry tree blossom in Kyoto, Japan
The vertical axis shows the date of peak blossom, expressed as the number of days since January 1st. The timing
of the peak cherry blossom is influenced by spring temperatures. Higher temperatures due to climate change
have caused the peak blossom to gradually move earlier in the year since the early 20th century.
Day of the year with peak cherry
Data source: Aono and Kazui (2008), Aono and Saito (2010), Katata (2026)
Note: The 30-year average is calculated when there are at least ten years with data in the 30-year window before the specified year.
